description:
PickTwist is interactive short drama you control.

Watch fast, full-screen episodes — and at the turning points, YOU choose what happens next. Forbidden romance, dangerous men, secrets that won't stay buried — and every twist is yours to pick.

What you can do:

- Shape the story
Tap to choose at key moments — your decisions steer how each scene plays out.

- Binge in minutes
Vertical, full-screen episodes made for your phone. One more, every time.

- Fall for the drama
Addictive worlds of romance, power, and betrayal — with cliffhangers that hit.

- Watch your way
Subscribe for the full catalogue, or unlock episodes one at a time with coins.

- Start free
The first episodes are on us. No account, no setup — just tap in.

PickTwist stories are created using generative AI.

Subscriptions: Prices vary by region and are shown in the app. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Auto-renews unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage or cancel anytime in your Apple ID settings.

Coins: Coin packs are one-time purchases and do not auto-renew. Coins are used to unlock individual episodes. Prices vary by region and are shown in the app.
